article_title: Catherine Zeta-Jones bases new role on funny Welsh people she knows

tasks.prompt: What is the main focus of the article?
options: How Catherine Zeta-Jones used her Welsh background and accent to shape her role in Kill Jackie
Why Catherine Zeta-Jones has decided to stop acting in television dramas
How the original Kill Jackie novel was filmed without any changes
Why Welsh actors are no longer allowed to use regional accents
tasks.correct_answer: How Catherine Zeta-Jones used her Welsh background and accent to shape her role in Kill Jackie
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתמקדת בכך שזיטה־ג'ונס עיצבה את הדמות בעזרת אנשים שהיא מכירה בוויילס והשתמשה לראשונה במבטא הסוונסי שלה בתפקיד דרמטי.

tasks.prompt: Who is Jackie Price in the new series?
options: A police officer investigating Hollywood actors
A former cocaine dealer being targeted by hitmen
A singer preparing for a concert in Swansea
A football manager working in Wrexham
tasks.correct_answer: A former cocaine dealer being targeted by hitmen
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בכתבה נאמר שג'קי פרייס היא סוחרת קוקאין לשעבר שרוצחים שכירים מנסים לפגוע בה.

tasks.prompt: What does Zeta-Jones mean when she says the adaptation “flipped” the book's central character?
options: The story was changed from a drama into a documentary.
The character moved from Wales to the United States.
The male character Jack was changed into a female character for her.
The ending of the book was shown before the beginning.
tasks.correct_answer: The male character Jack was changed into a female character for her.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: flipped מתאר כאן שינוי מרכזי בעיבוד: הדמות הגברית ג'ק מן הספר הפכה לדמות הנשית ג'קי.

tasks.prompt: What was new for Zeta-Jones about making Kill Jackie?
options: It was her first role as an actor.
It was her first time working with a creative team.
It was her first series based on a book.
It was her first drama filmed in Wales and her first role using her Swansea accent.
tasks.correct_answer: It was her first drama filmed in Wales and her first role using her Swansea accent.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: זהו התפקיד הראשון שבו השתמשה במבטא הסוונסי שלה והדרמה הראשונה שלה שצולמה בוויילס.

tasks.prompt: When Zeta-Jones says her Welsh choices would “ground” her in the character, what does “ground” mean?
options: Make her performance feel more real and connected to a familiar background
Prevent her from travelling during filming
Make the character less important to the story
Force her to speak without any accent
tasks.correct_answer: Make her performance feel more real and connected to a familiar background
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ground פירושו לעגן את המשחק במשהו מוכר ואמיתי, וכך להוסיף לדמות אמינות וגוונים שהיא מכירה מחייה.

tasks.prompt: How did Tom Jones become part of one scene in the series?
options: He appears as Jackie's brother.
His song accompanies a security system hidden behind prints of him.
He directed the scene in Swansea.
He plays one of the hitmen chasing Jackie.
tasks.correct_answer: His song accompanies a security system hidden behind prints of him.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: זיטה־ג'ונס הציעה להשתמש בשיר של טום ג'ונס ובתמונות בסגנון אנדי וורהול שמאחוריהן מסתתרת מערכת אבטחה עם כלי נשק.

tasks.prompt: Give two reasons Zeta-Jones wanted Jackie Price to be Welsh.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שתי סיבות מפורשות או משתמעות מן הכתבה ולנסח אותן בקצרה.
expected_points: She had never played a role using her real Swansea accent.
She had never filmed a drama in Wales.
Her Welsh background helped ground the character and add nuances she understood.
She drew inspiration from funny, real and tough people she knows in Wales.

tasks.prompt: Why did fans respond strongly to Zeta-Jones using her Welsh accent?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסיק מדוע הבחירה במבטא הייתה משמעותית למעריצים ולבסס את התשובה בפרט מן הכתבה.
expected_points: Fans rarely hear her use her own Welsh accent in a dramatic role.
The accent highlighted her continuing connection and pride in Wales.
Comments described excitement at hearing her sound Welsh, and she said their reaction made her happy.

tasks.prompt: Summarise how Zeta-Jones changed and personalised the character of Jackie Price.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך להזכיר את השינוי מן הספר, המבטא הוולשי, מקור ההשראה ולפחות תרומה יצירתית אחת שלה.
expected_points: The book's male American character Jack was adapted into the female Jackie Price.
Zeta-Jones chose to make Jackie Welsh and use her Swansea accent.
She based aspects of the performance on comedic and tough people she knows in Wales.
As executive producer, she also contributed ideas such as the Tom Jones security-system scene.

tasks.prompt: Using evidence from the article, explain how an actor's personal background can make a fictional character feel more authentic.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג טענה ברורה, להשתמש בשתי ראיות לפחות מן הכתבה ולהסביר כיצד הן מוסיפות אמינות לדמות.
expected_points: Her Swansea accent made the character sound real and connected to a specific place.
People she knows in Wales inspired both the humour and toughness of Jackie.
Her knowledge of Welsh culture helped her add details and nuances to the performance.
